headline: A detective story your kids solve by searching the room you're sitting in.

steps.hunt: The kids hunt the room for the thing in the riddle.
steps.type: You type what they found. A clue drops.

example.label: from the case files
example.title: The Case of the Missing Midnight Cookie
example.riddle: I have hands but never clap. Find me and tell me which number my short hand points at.
example.note: any clock counts. Whatever number they say is right.
example.exhibit: Whoever took it left flour on the stairs.

free: No sign-up. First case is free.
facts: five evenings · about 15 minutes each · ages 4 to 10
